draft.text: You came in because you were given a special mask by 911 to help you breathe and you wanted to talk about how you're feeling after being in the hospital for heart failure.
We talked about your health history, including chronic kidney disease and high blood pressure.
You are taking some medications but aren't sure about the exact doses.
You had an episode of heart failure that got better in the hospital.
You still have swelling in your ankles and had shortness of breath, but that has improved.
You need to follow up with your primary care doctor to get your blood test results and talk about your medicines.
You should keep taking your medications and watch for any new or worse symptoms.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you were feeling better after being hospitalized for a heart failure episode.
You have a history of chronic kidney disease and high blood pressure.
You are taking medications for these conditions, but you don't remember the exact doses.
You had an acute heart failure episode that improved with hospital care.
You still have swelling in your ankles and may need to watch for any new symptoms.
You will need to see your primary care doctor to get your blood test results and talk about your medications and kidney function.
